career_spells.evidence_note: Founded with brother2001,2018 employer policy confirms executive director,2025 speech describes recent site work and exit by29July. Retain year end rather than assuming election/first service/share transfer is employment exit. Family-owned contractor; government/mining contracts do not make employer public. Long days/FIFO and title are insufficient full-time evidence. Precise legal payroll entities across rebranding unresolved. ABR identifies operating-brand entity ABN52 132 968 800: Whitten Bros Constructions(2008), Whittens(WA)(2011), Whittens Pty Limited(2012); distinct Group entity ABN21 159 874 085 originated as Whittens WA Civil Constructions in2012. These strengthen legal-entity mapping but do not resolve which paid him in each period or establish employment at incorporation. Later reporting based on ASIC records says he ceased as Whittens Group director and secretary in December2024, while ownership changed on29July2025. Corporate office and share-transfer dates are not automatically employment or operational-work endpoints; preserve year-level end pending payroll/contract evidence. Contemporary2015 Mining Chronicle quotes him as Whittens director on company contract; observation within existing tenure, not new employer or full-time confirmation.
